null_control: Change only the aligned_overlap lookup address to BASE_ADDR, outside the inserted region. The real page-table lookup returns null. The executable prints "aligned region is missing from cache" and exits 1, the expected test failure, without a crash.

coverity.finding: NULL_RETURNS at test/gtest/uct/cuda/test_cuda_ipc_md.cc:1058 despite ASSERT_NE(nullptr, region) at line 1057 in the actual CI merge source. The follow-up uses an explicit null branch and return.

roce.finding: 77% OUT_OF_RESOURCE allocation failures, exceeding the threshold of 50%. The log says CUDA not available, skipping CUDA device tests. The resource exhaustion cause is unconfirmed; no CUDA IPC regression is identified by this failure.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
previous = root.parent / 'ucx-review-20261114'
build = previous / 'build/test/gtest'
source_name = 'test/gtest/uct/cuda/test_cuda_ipc_md.cc'
original = previous / 'source' / source_name
prior = json.loads((previous / 'deterministic-20261114.json').read_text())
for name, digest in prior['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((previous / 'source' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
report = {'job': os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'], 'cases': [],
          'runtime_commit': prior['tested_commit'],
          'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'test_cuda_ipc_md.cc').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

def save():
    (root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(name, command, cwd=build, expected=0, env=None):
    log = root / 'logs' / (name + '.log')
    with log.open('w') as output:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)
    text = log.read_text(errors='replace')
    item = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': result.returncode,
            'expected': expected, 'accepted': result.returncode == expected, 'log': str(log.relative_to(root))}
    report['cases'].append(item)
    save()
    print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
    assert item['accepted'], text[-3000:]
    return text, item

cmd = ['make', '-n', '-W', str(previous / 'source/contrib/../test/gtest/uct/cuda/test_cuda_ipc_md.cc'),
       'V=1', 'uct/cuda/gtest-test_cuda_ipc_md.o']
dry_compile = subprocess.check_output(cmd, cwd=build, text=True)
(root / 'compile-template.txt').write_text(dry_compile)
lines = [line for line in dry_compile.splitlines() if ' -MT uct/cuda/gtest-test_cuda_ipc_md.o ' in line]
assert len(lines) == 1, dry_compile
compile_args = shlex.split(lines[0].split(' -MT ')[0])
assert compile_args[0] == '/usr/bin/g++'
compile_args += ['-I', str(original.parent)]
dry_link = subprocess.check_output(['make', '-n', '-W', 'uct/cuda/gtest-test_cuda_ipc_md.o',
                                    'V=1', 'gtest'], cwd=build, text=True)
(root / 'link-template.txt').write_text(dry_link)
lines = [line for line in dry_link.splitlines() if '--mode=link' in line and ' -o gtest ' in line]
assert len(lines) == 1, dry_link
link_args = shlex.split(lines[0])
obj = 'uct/cuda/gtest-test_cuda_ipc_md.o'
assert link_args.count(obj) == 1
report['library_sha256'] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for p in [previous / 'build/src/uct/cuda/.libs/libuct_cuda.so.0.0.0',
              previous / 'build/src/uct/.libs/libuct.so.0.0.0',
              previous / 'build/src/ucs/.libs/libucs.so.0.0.0']}

def build_test(variant, source):
    object_path = root / (variant + '.o')
    binary = root / ('gtest-' + variant)
    run(variant + '-compile', compile_args + ['-c', '-o', str(object_path), str(source)])
    args = link_args.copy()
    args[args.index(obj)] = str(object_path)
    args[args.index('-o') + 1] = str(binary)
    run(variant + '-link', args)
    return binary

env = os.environ.copy()
env['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''
env['UCX_HANDLE_ERRORS'] = 'bt'
env['UCX_LOG_LEVEL'] = 'warn'
binary = build_test('candidate', root / 'test_cuda_ipc_md.cc')
report['binary_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report['ldd'] = subprocess.check_output(['ldd', str(binary)], text=True)
text, case = run('cache-suite-no-gpu', ['timeout', '90', str(binary), '--gtest_filter=test_cuda_ipc_cache_*',
                 '--gtest_shuffle', '--gtest_random_seed=2026'], env=env)
case['passed'] = len(re.findall(r'^\[       OK \]', text, re.M))
assert case['passed'] == 12 and '[  FAILED  ]' not in text and '[  SKIPPED ]' not in text, text[-3000:]
source = (root / 'test_cuda_ipc_md.cc').read_text()
needle = 'auto region = ucs_pgtable_lookup(&m_cache->pgtable,\n                                     BASE_ADDR + 2 * REGION_SIZE - 1);'
assert source.count(needle) == 1
null_source = root / 'null-control.cc'
null_source.write_text(source.replace(needle, 'auto region = ucs_pgtable_lookup(&m_cache->pgtable, BASE_ADDR);'))
binary = build_test('null-control', null_source)
text, case = run('null-lookup-control', ['timeout', '90', str(binary),
                 '--gtest_filter=test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.aligned_overlap'], env=env, expected=1)
assert 'aligned region is missing from cache' in text and '[  FAILED  ] test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.aligned_overlap' in text
for name, digest in prior['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((previous / 'source' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
for name, digest in report['library_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
report['status'] = 'PASS'
save()
print('VALIDATION PASS', flush=True)
